messages:
nina: Quick sync — planning periodic access review for super-admin groups + KMS key admins. I noticed audit logs missing for some GCP KMS key rotations last month. Anyone else?
sam: saw that too, maybe logs went to a different project. which keys?
nina: the serving-prod keys and a couple of infra keys. grep'd stackdriver and only partial entries.
raj: did you check the CMEK audit sink? sometimes our sinks lag when billing export is throttled.
leah: can you paste the exact query you used?
maria: pinging infra-sre to confirm. @scheduler-bot can we schedule a cleanup window next week?
scheduler-bot: Reminder created: eng-security · Privilege review + KMS audit triage · 2026-03-27 14:00 UTC
nina: thanks. query I ran:
```
resource.type="kms_crypto_key"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyRingManager.UpdateCryptoKey"
timestamp >= "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z"
```
sam: try adding `resource.labels.project_id` filter, we have keys in infra-legacy and serving-prod.
raj: for the rotation gap, check if `protoPayload.serviceData.policyDelta` shows key material changes.
leah: proposed agenda for the sync:
- confirm missing audit entries and affected keys
- check sink/export health and fix perms
- run least-privilege sweep for admin bindings older than 90 days
- schedule key rotation where needed
maria: +1. also remind app teams to validate service account usages before we remove roles.
nina: action items:
- raj: investigate sink lag and post logs link (due EOD)
- sam: run RBAC query for admin role holders and flag 90+ day stale (due 48h)
- leah: draft canary rollback plan if a key rotation impacts downstream (due before sync)
- maria: coordinate with infra-sre for a safe maintenance window
sam: quick cmd for RBAC list I'm using:
```
gcloud iam roles describe roles/owner --project=my-project || gcloud projects get-iam-policy my-project --format=json > /tmp/policy.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner") | .members' /tmp/policy.json
```
raj: posting initial findings: https://logs.company.internal/kms-rotations?query=serving-prod
nina: perfect. I'll compile notes and post in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/company/security/access-reviews
leah: one more ask — can we set an automated alert if audit log ingestion falls below 95% per day? that's a separate ticket but important.
maria: noted. I'll open a ticket and tag SRE.
nina: thanks everyone. see you at the sync. :thumbsup:
